rows.label: tlk70000052_02_msg0001
rows.name:
Adel-sama! I need to tell
you... I've set a day to
visit my grandmother.

rows.label: tlk70000052_02_msg0002
rows.name:
I'm not going home. I'm going to a
Superbian doctor instead. Grandma's
condition doesn't seem good...

rows.label: tlk70000052_02_msg0003
rows.name:
I'll be away from Iira for a time,
while I provide her with support...

rows.label: tlk70000052_02_msg0004
rows.name:
Everyone at the manor and Montos-san
even prepared flowers for her.
Sniff... My eyes are leaking...

rows.label: tlk70000052_02_msg0005
rows.name:
Everyone in Aletta helped me,
and I have goodbyes to make, so
I'll stay a little longer...

rows.label: tlk70000052_02_msg0006
rows.name:
I'm going to burn the scenery of Iira
into my memory while I still can.

rows.label: tlk70000052_02_msg0007
rows.name:
I'll miss it, but this is goodbye to
Adel-sama for a while too. Thank you
for everything, truly!!
